summary: Russian forces conducted multiple strikes across Ukraine overnight, targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Ukrainian forces reported destroying a Russian Mi-28 helicopter and striking 20 ships in the Black Sea. The threat level remains elevated with continuous attacks reported across multiple regions.
key_points: Ukrainian forces reported destroying a Russian Mi-28 helicopter on Belgorod region (Source: @UkraineNow/82661).
Ukrainian forces struck 20 ships in the Black Sea overnight, including 17 oil tankers and 2 gas carriers (Source: @UkraineNow/82656).
Multiple drone attacks reported across Ukraine including reactive drones from Kharkiv toward Zhytomyr region (Source: @kpszsu/68612).
Russian forces attacked Krivoy Rog region causing civilian casualties including a 13-year-old boy and a 62-year-old truck driver (Source: @UkraineNow/82664).
Threat of missile strikes from southeast direction reported (Source: @tass_agency/385416).
Reactiv drones launched from Dnipro region toward Solonog region (Source: @eRadarrua/101223).
Active hostile tactical aviation activity reported on eastern front with threat of aerial weapons deployment (Source: @kpszsu/68624).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue aggressive strikes across Ukraine targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Ukrainian forces demonstrate capability to strike Russian assets including helicopters and naval vessels. The threat level remains high with continuous attacks reported across multiple regions.
sections.regional_response: European Union continues support for Ukraine with temporary refugee protection extended to 2028. Estonia proposes stripping IOC of EU funding due to Russia's sports return. EU ambassadors failed to agree on 21st sanctions package against Russia, talks postponed to next week.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian forces demonstrate advanced capabilities in both offensive and defensive operations. Russian forces show pattern of targeting civilian infrastructure and causing casualties. The conflict remains highly volatile with continuous escalation across all fronts.
